newsitem.title: USA: Dean Foods Q4 dairy earnings rises.
newsitem.headline: Dean Foods Q4 dairy earnings rises.

text.p: Dean Foods Co said Wednesday its dairy segment reported operating earnings of $34.1 million in the fiscal fourth quarter, up from year-ago earnings of $21.0 million before a special charge.

"Performance improved in each of our fluid milk, ice cream and extended shelf life dairy operations as a result of increased volume and improved operating efficiencies," Howard, Dean, chairman, said in a statement.
The vegetable segment reported operating earnings of $10.4 million, compared with a year-ago loss of $6.0 million before a special charge.

The pickles segment reported operating earnings of $11.3 million, up from $9.5 million a year ago before a charge, due to improvements in procurement, operating efficiencies and promotion management, the company said.
The specialty segment's fourth-quarter operating earnings were $9.2 million, up from $7.9 million before a charge.
"The specialty segment experienced another strong quarter, primarily the result of higher sales volumes and earnings from its non-dairy coffee creamer and dips products," Dean said.

Overall, Dean Foods reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended May 25 of $0.73 a share, up from year-ago earnings of $0.29 before a special charge of $150.0 million. Including the charge, the year-ago fourth quarter loss was $2.15 a share. For fiscal 1997, it earned $2.16 a share, up from $1.20 a share before a charge.
"We're confident our emphasis on cost reduction and growth in our core businesses through acquisitions and innovative marketing will continue to improve performance in the future," Dean said.
